headline.en: Vornado, Related's 85 10th Avenue CMBS Loan Sent to Special Servicing
headline.zh: Vornado、Related旗下85 10th Avenue的CMBS贷款被移交特别服务

summary.en: A $396 million CMBS loan secured by 85 10th Avenue, a 633,000-square-foot Manhattan office property owned jointly by Vornado Realty Trust and the Related Companies, has been sent to special servicing due to imminent maturity default, according to a Morningstar Credit alert. The loan makes up DBWF 2016-85T and is part of the larger conduits CD 2017-CD3 and BACM 2017-BNK3, with a December 2026 maturity date. Morningstar reported the building's cash flow fell 28 percent below underwriting in 2025, and Google is the largest tenant at 47 percent of the space.
summary.zh: 根据Morningstar Credit的预警，由曼哈顿切尔西区63.3万平方英尺办公楼85 10th Avenue担保的3.96亿美元CMBS贷款因即将到期违约被移交特别服务。该贷款构成DBWF 2016-85T，并属于更大的CD 2017-CD3和BACM 2017-BNK3 conduit，到期日为2026年12月。Morningstar报告称该建筑2025年现金流较承销假设低28%，Google为最大租户，占用47%的空间。

7766be2db755.relevance_reason: A CMBS loan transfer to special servicing involving Vornado and Related, neither of which is a tracked manager; no tracked sub-sector exposure.

headline.en: Aperture litigation credit platform tops $600m, reaching $1bn capacity
headline.zh: Aperture诉讼信贷平台资产突破6亿美元，投资能力达10亿美元

summary.en: Aperture Investors has expanded its litigation-focused private credit platform to more than $600m in assets under management, the firm said, giving the Litigation Finance Private Credit platform approximately $1bn in total investment capacity. The strategy, led by portfolio manager Luke Darkow, makes structured loans primarily to law firms, collateralised by expected legal fee receivables from post-settlement, procedurally mature, near-settlement and short-duration cases. Aperture, founded in partnership with Generali Investments, manages around $6.72bn in assets.
summary.zh: Aperture Investors表示，其专注诉讼融资的私募信贷平台已扩大至超过6亿美元的资产管理规模，使Aperture的Litigation Finance Private Credit平台总投资能力达到约10亿美元。该策略由诉讼融资投资组合经理Luke Darkow领导，主要向律所提供结构性贷款，以和解后、程序成熟、接近和解及短周期的法律案件预期法律费用应收款作为抵押。Aperture与Generali Investments合作创立，管理约67.2亿美元资产。

reason.en: Aperture is not a tracked manager; the expansion of its litigation credit platform to more than $600m AUM and roughly $1bn investment capacity is incremental sector news for private credit.
reason.zh: Aperture不属于已追踪管理人；其诉讼信贷平台资产规模扩大至逾6亿美元、投资能力约10亿美元，对私募信贷而言属增量行业消息。

headline.en: Managers Build 401(k) Teams a Year After Alternatives Order
headline.zh: 另类资产行政令一年后，管理机构组建401(k)团队

summary.en: A year after President Donald Trump's executive order allowing alternatives into 401(k) retirement accounts, managers have set up defined contribution teams, struck partnerships and launched new funds. In March, the Department of Labor proposed a rule creating process-based safe harbors for plan fiduciaries selecting 401(k) investment alternatives, but litigation risk and reservations persist. The 401(k) market is described as a near $14tn opportunity.
summary.zh: 在总统Donald Trump签署允许另类资产进入401(k)退休账户的行政令一年后，各管理机构已设立固定缴款团队、建立合作关系并推出新基金。今年3月，美国劳工部（DOL）提出一项规则，为计划受托人在选择401(k)投资替代品时设立基于流程的“安全港”，但诉讼风险和顾虑依然存在。文章称401(k)市场规模接近14万亿美元。

710cf91fb0dd.relevance_reason: Tracks how private credit managers are positioning for 401(k) flows a year after the executive order, with DOL safe harbors and remaining litigation barriers shaping deployment and fundraising conditions.

summary.en: Onex reported total fee-generating assets under management of approximately $43.2bn at the end of the second quarter, with Onex Credit fee-generating AUM of $30.6bn versus $29.8bn at end-2025. headline.zh: Homestead首只农业私人信贷基金完成首次募集

headline.en: CPP Investments posts strongest quarter in over a decade on real assets and credit
headline.zh: CPP Investments 凭借实物资产和信贷创下十多年来最强季度表现

summary.en: CPP Investments reported its strongest quarterly investment performance in more than a decade for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, ending 30 June 2026 with net assets of C$863.6bn, up from C$793.3bn. Net income of C$60.2bn and C$10.1bn in net transfers drove a C$70.3bn increase, with a 7.5 per cent quarterly net return and a 9.4 per cent 10-year annualised net return. Credit commitments during the quarter included US$1bn to Blackstone Private Credit Fund and approximately €270m to finance a portfolio of European corporate loans originated by an Ares Management fund.

headline.en: Sculptor resets and upsizes US CLO XXXIII by $45m
headline.zh: Sculptor重置并增募美国CLO XXXIII，规模增加4500万美元

summary.en: Sculptor Capital Management has reset and upsized its US CLO, Sculptor CLO XXXIII, by $45m from its original closing. The reset establishes a new five-year reinvestment period and a two-year non-call period, with JP Morgan arranging the transaction. Sculptor's global ICS platform manages CLOs and collateralised bond obligations totalling approximately $12.5bn.
summary.zh: Sculptor Capital Management已重置并增募其美国CLO——Sculptor CLO XXXIII，规模较初始关闭时增加4500万美元。此次重置设立了新的五年再投资期和两年非赎回期，交易由JP Morgan安排。Sculptor的全球ICS平台管理着总额约125亿美元的CLO和担保债券凭证。

reason.en: A CLO reset and $45m upsize at a non-tracked manager is an incremental capital-markets event with no direct tracked-manager involvement.
reason.zh: 非跟踪管理人的CLO重置及4500万美元增募属于增量资本市场事件，无直接涉及跟踪管理人。

9e61981ea5b4.relevance_reason: Sculptor is not a tracked manager and the CLO reset/upsize has no direct transmission to tracked GP credit strategies.

headline.en: Goldman Sachs Alternatives tops $10bn for European evergreen private credit strategy
headline.zh: Goldman Sachs Alternatives 欧洲常青私募信贷策略资产突破100亿美元

summary.en: Goldman Sachs Alternatives has surpassed $10bn in assets for its evergreen European private credit strategy, launched in October 2023 within its European senior direct lending platform. The strategy invests alongside the firm's flagship closed-ended senior direct lending funds and holds exposure to more than 400 companies, including private credit loans to over 100 firms.
summary.zh: Goldman Sachs Alternatives 的欧洲常青私募信贷策略资产规模已突破100亿美元，该策略于2023年10月在其欧洲优先直接贷款平台下推出。该策略与公司旗舰封闭式优先直接贷款基金系列共同投资，目前投资组合覆盖逾400家公司，其中包括对100多家企业的私募信贷贷款。

reason.en: A fundraising milestone for an untracked manager, indicating continued capital formation in European direct lending but no tracked manager involvement.
reason.zh: 未追踪管理人的募资里程碑，显示欧洲直接贷款领域资本形成持续，但无追踪管理人参与。
